record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.1 and learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Less dropout may preserve useful context in median seven-to-eight-item histories, while smaller updates may stabilize the less regularized network. Unlike the earlier unsuccessful wider-model trial, retain width 64, two blocks, two heads and 2× feed-forward width. Keep batch size 128, history length 128, features, embedding normalization/tying, loss and optimizer unchanged. Retain seed 42, the 200-epoch cap, 200 batches per epoch and one checkpoint per category.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four category models, reduce dropout to preserve context in short histories and lower the learning rate to stabilize updates with less regularization. Preserve model dimensions, loss, optimizer and training limits. The predictor already loads the trained architecture and disables dropout during inference.
